convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for XMA_Range_Bands indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator cannot be replicated with built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar

other_exits: Long position closed when Close[1] < Lower_Band[1] and BuyPosClose is enabled
Short position closed when Close[1] > Upper_Band[1] and SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values = fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values = share of deposit in a deal. Default MM=-0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses a two-bar confirmation: bar[1] must be outside the band to establish signal, bar[0] must cross back inside to trigger entry. This is a mean-reversion strategy - buys when price was above upper band[1] and crosses back below upper band[0], sells when price was below lower band[1] and crosses back above lower band[0]. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar. Recount flag ensures data is re-read if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are input booleans that gate trade permissions. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with unknown internal position management logic. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests trade state is stored in global variables.
python_conversion_notes: Requires porting the XMA_Range_Bands custom indicator which depends on SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (9+ smoothing methods including JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). TradeAlgorithms.mqh must also be ported for position open/close logic including lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=deposit fraction), signal time tracking, and global variable management. The mean-reversion entry logic (outside band then cross back inside) is straightforward to replicate. SL/TP are in points so digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers must be handled. SignalBar parameter shifts which bar is used for signal detection - default is bar[1] (previous completed bar).
